## What this contribution changes

Describe the suite, test case, evaluator, or documentation change.

## What behavior it measures

Explain the intended signal and what conclusions should not be drawn from it.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I used a stable suite ID and semantic version.
- [ ] I documented important limitations and false-positive or false-negative risks.
- [ ] I declared the author and content license.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, personal data, executable content, or unsafe operational details.
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate` and `npm run build` locally.
- [ ] I incremented the suite version if prompts or evaluators changed.
